title: Strieber's childhood mind-control camp at Randolph AFB
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Strieber's childhood mind-control camp at Randolph AFB, about 1950s at Texas (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: summer camp at Randolph Air Force Base near their home in Texas >> where Strieber alleges that he was subjected to various types of physical torture and mind control experiments

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast, relays a claim made by Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing encounters with strange beings. According to Jorjani, Strieber says that as a child in the 1950s he was sent to a summer camp at Randolph Air Force Base, a US military base near his family's home in Texas, where he alleges he suffered physical torture and mind control experiments. If true, it would mean the military experimented on children.
